policy.stiffness_definition: Dimensionless artist resistance parameter0..1, larger meansless motion; not spring constant or measured physical stiffness.
policy.caps_definition: Maximum absolute proposed rotation from rest and tip displacement at1536x1024 scene; both caps apply, choose more restrictive. No displacement of roots/contact pivots.

rigid.pivot_rule: Ground contact or fixed support. Do not sway architecture, pots, main trunks, main branches, ground or contact shadows.

flexible_branch.pivot_rule: Local flexible-branch joint where it meets static wood; unresolved joint staysnull and motiondisabled until alignmentreview.

foliage_mass.pivot_rule: Own leaf-mass root/branch anchor, not whole-scene pivot. Compoundgroupsrequireindividualextraction/masks.

grass_tip.pivot_rule: Base of isolated blade/tipgroup; lawnpaint/soil/rootline remainrigid. No whole-groundwarp.

art_safety_limits.alpha_or_lightness_flicker: No procedural opacity/color pulsation; nearest resampling or subpixel treatment must be reviewed for pixel shimmer.
art_safety_limits.review: Mild/strong areartistlabels only, no weather-speed conversion. Reject visible jointgaps, leafstretch, clippedtips or groundcontactdrift.

notes: Source perches/feeder/bath use generic catalog slots, not the detailed art sprite anchors. No claim that these slots already align.
No claim arbitrary movable plants, art skin switching or direct manifest import is currently supported.
The manifest pixels_per_world_unit values on props are provisional art direction; they do not calibrate this yard perspective.
No collisions/water flow/pump behavior/wind animation are implemented by this audit.

limitations: Detailed pixel style and owner acceptance not established by this structural audit.
Common starter arrangement, instance positions and scale calibration are not supplied or invented.
All compound layers remain flattened internally; optional layer omission does not imply semantic per-object editability.
Generated scene vegetation has no inferred plant taxon; canonical IDs are not assigned from visual resemblance.
San Diego default excludes snowy/autumn-orange overlays; planned state metadata is not generated variant art.
